channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Anthropic to disclose new revenue numbers as AI lab financials become central to tech trade
item.description: Anthropic will release updated financials to a group of investors gathering at its headquarters this week, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Trump's diesel deal with Russia equals less than two weeks of U.S. demand
item.description: President Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia comes as he is under pressure to reduce fuel prices with the U.S. midterm elections less than a month way.

item.title: Paul Tudor Jones says 2027 could be a really challenging year for the stock market
item.description: The billionaire investor said that corporate buybacks, along with mergers and acquisitions, that have been a tail wind for the bull market are about to turn.

item.title: Stocks fall after bank earnings deluge; chipmakers slide: Live updates
item.description: Traders digested a slew of corporate earnings reports from major banks along with a steep overnight decline in South Korea that put pressure on memory names.

item.title: Micron, Seagate, Western Digital sink as chip sell-off deepens
item.description: Technology stocks tumbled Tuesday as a sell-off in U.S. semiconductor shares spilled into Asian and European markets.

item.title: The SpaceX threat to telecom is real. How it could play out
item.description: SpaceX’s spectrum push has rattled Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile. Analysts see several paths for Starlink to challenge U.S. wireless.

item.title: Iran reportedly fortifies nuclear sites as it prepares for possible U.S. strikes after midterms
item.description: A Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis – a Yemeni militant group backed by Tehran – said it had intercepted another attack on Riyadh.

item.title: Apple releases HomeView smart home hub with screen as showcase for Siri AI
item.description: The iPhone maker also announced the new Apple TV 4K and HomePod Mini.

item.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns as ambassador to Greece at White House's request
item.description: The White House had asked U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle to resign, press secretary Katie Zacharia said Tuesday in her debut briefing.

item.title: Bank earnings: Here's how JPMorgan, Goldman, Wells Fargo and Citi performed in Q3
item.description: JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, Goldman Sachs and Citigroup reported third-quarter earnings on Tuesday, with mixed results.

item.title: French supermarket fridges get hacked, heating to 122°F and sparking fires
item.description: Hackers targeted hundreds of French supermarkets in a large-scale cyberattack, causing refrigerators to overheat, spoiling food, and sparking fires.

item.title: In charts: How one of the world's biggest economies got trapped by debt
item.description: France opens debate on its 2027 budget as high deficits, rising debt and student protests intensify pressure on lawmakers.

item.title: Paul Tudor Jones is bullish on oil, says it could rally another $20-$25 because of Iran conflict
Huge profits at tech and energy companies are masking this key trend
item.description: Despite the uneven start to the reporting period, FactSet data shows year-on-year S&P 500 earnings growth is still tracking at nearly 30%.

item.title: Martin Shkreli violated lifetime pharma industry ban, FTC and states say in contempt claim
item.description: Shkreli was banned from the pharmaceutical industry after a trial found that he organized an illegal scheme to perpetuate a monopoly for the drug Daraprim.

item.title: Why this little known Chinese chipmaker has caused a global stock rout
item.description: China's leading memory chipmaker CXMT has reportedly made progress on new designs.

item.title: Six Flags shares decline following deadly roller coaster incident
item.description: One person died and several others were injured in an incident involving the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia, according to reports.

item.title: Thousands of homeowners face adjustable-rate mortgage resets — and much higher payments
item.description: Adjustable-rate mortgages with low introductory interest rates are facing their first adjustment at a time when rates are much higher, according to new data.

item.title: UnitedHealth Group tops estimates, hikes profit outlook as insurer manages high medical costs
item.description: UnitedHealth Group said it expects 2026 adjusted earnings of at least $20.50 per share, up from a previous outlook of $19.50 to $20.00 per share.

item.title: BlackRock and Baillie Gifford bet big on Icon 3D printed homes
item.description: Icon, one of the biggest players in 3D printed real estate, is announcing its $200 million Series D financing co-led by Baillie Gifford and funds managed by BlackRock, among others.

item.title: We're adding to a consumer staples stock in advance of a big catalyst
item.description: We see this company's pending merger as a potential for cost savings, incremental revenue synergies, and increased scale.

item.title: Here's what personal loan lenders look for when you apply
item.description: Your credit score isn't the only thing that matters when applying for a personal loan. Here's what lenders look at and how a co-signer could help.

item.title: The stock market is at a critical juncture. Wall Street is convinced it will resolve in the bulls' favor
item.description: There's an extraordinary split between the headline S&P 500 pinned just under a record high and the median stock in the index struggling in a 16% drawdown.

item.title: Trump census plan to cut noncitizens from 2030 count spurs critics toward legal fight
item.description: The Trump administration's proposal to exclude some noncitizens from the 2030 census prompts alarm for voting rights groups.

item.title: J&J beats earnings estimates, eyes mid-2027 hip and knee unit spinoff
item.description: Pharmaceutical sales jumped 7.7% in the quarter ⁠to $16.76 billion, but medical technology division sales rose just 2.5% to $8.6 billion.

item.title: Elon Musk gives $276 million to Republican groups, becomes biggest known 2026 midterm donor
item.description: Musk’s record midterm election spending comes as the Tesla and SpaceX CEO rebuilds his relationship with Trump and has business ties to the federal government.

item.title: Visa gets Beijing's green light for bank card business after 40 years of working with China
item.description: The incremental approval comes as the U.S. and Chinese presidents are due to meet for a third time this year next month.

item.title: As 'Cockroach' protests grow over alleged voter fraud, Modi defends India as ‘mother of democracy’
item.description: Protests in India demanding the removal of the chief election commissioner for alleged voter fraud have intensified.

item.title: SpaceX agrees to testify to NYC Council about AI safety after receiving subpoena
item.description: SpaceX has agreed to testify before the New York City Council as part of an investigation into AI safety risks.

item.title: Rep. Ilhan Omar blasts federal criminal raid on home: 'I will not be silenced'
item.description: The Minnesota Democrat, a Muslim who was born in Somalia, has been targeted for criticism in the past by President Donald Trump.
